description: Attach real product screenshots you already have on disk to one of your tracked products, so check_submission_readiness and generate_submission_kit stop reporting screenshots as missing. This is the one asset that blocks the five highest-authority directories in the catalogue (G2, Product Hunt, Capterra, SourceForge and TrustRadius all require a gallery), so filling it once unblocks all five for that product. IMPORTANT: this tool uploads nothing by itself and cannot. The Sellular server is remote, so it cannot read your machine; it authorises YOU to send the bytes and returns the exact curl command per file, valid for ten minutes and for this product only. It never fetches, generates, resizes or substitutes an image: only a file a human already has can enter the gallery. Directories want 3-5 images, PNG or JPG, at least 1280x720. Re-sending the same file is safe: it corrects that image rather than adding a duplicate. Nothing is ever deleted. Account-scoped: requires the MCP_API_KEY bearer token, and asks you to confirm before authorising.

files.description: Local paths of the screenshots you hold, best first (the order becomes the gallery order), e.g. ["/home/you/shots/01-home.png"]. Only pass paths you have verified exist: a ticket cannot check them, so a wrong path simply fails at the command.

product.description: Product id, name or domain (substring match). Optional when the account tracks one product.

name: attach_product_screenshots
